source: Pinned Linux CLI 1.3.1 public binary schema-converter symbol
schema_symbol: go.shape.struct { ServerName string "jsonschema:\"required\" jsonschema_description:\"Name of the MCP server.\""; ToolName string "jsonschema:\"required\" jsonschema_description:\"Name of the tool to call.\""; Arguments encoding/json/jsontext.Value "jsonschema:\"required\" jsonschema_description:\"Arguments to pass to the tool.\"" }]
confirmed_boundary: The pinned CLI schema converter uses jsontext.Value for required Arguments; it is not declared as string. Before the compatibility fix, Nodia dispatcher gate required a JSON string decoded to an object. The fix accepts an object or a JSON string decoded to an object, using the same bounded parser and rejecting nonfinite numbers, excess size/depth and nonobject shapes. StdioBridge already supported both encodings under its explicit CLI compatibility flag.
limitations: The rejected payload was not read. arguments_type+dispatcher only proves Arguments was not a string; it does not distinguish object, array, number, boolean or null. Embedded symbol inspection does not execute the CLI validation path.
